# graviteeam_alert_notifier (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Alert Notifier

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_alert_notifier" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name      = "Slack Webhook"
  type      = "webhook-notifier"
  enabled   = true
  configuration = jsonencode({
    url    = "https://hooks.slack.example.com/xxx"
    method = "POST"
    body   = "{\"text\": \"Alert: {{alert.name}}\"}"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String) JSON configuration for the alert notifier
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `name` (String) The name of the alert notifier
- `type` (String) The alert notifier type

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alert notifier is enabled

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the alert notifier
